ios.desc:
Barqly Rider is the delivery workspace for registered Barqly riders.

The app helps approved riders go online, receive delivery jobs, accept pickup requests, view route details, share live delivery location, update pickup and delivery status, and complete deliveries securely.

Riders can manage verification details, saved work locations, delivery history, earnings, payout information, ratings, notifications, support requests, referrals, and profile settings.

Barqly Rider is intended only for registered riders approved to deliver orders on the Barqly platform.

android.desc:
Barqly Rider helps delivery partners manage orders, complete deliveries, and stay connected on the road.

Use the app to receive delivery tasks, view pickup and drop-off details, navigate active orders, verify completed deliveries, and keep track of your rider activity in one place.

With Barqly Rider, you can:

Sign in and manage your rider account
View available and active delivery tasks
Access pickup and customer delivery information
Use live location features during deliveries
Verify order handoff and completion
Review delivery history and rider performance
Track payout and earnings information
Stay updated with order and support notifications
Barqly Rider is built for speed, clarity, and reliable delivery operations so riders can manage their work efficiently from pickup to drop-off.

Download Barqly Rider and deliver with confidence.

Background Location Tracking for Delivery Dispatch Barqly Rider requires access to your background location to function properly as a delivery application. When you go "Online", the app uses a foreground service to continuously track your location, even when the app is closed or minimized. This is a core feature that allows our dispatch system to send you the most relevant, nearby delivery jobs and provides live ETA tracking for customers waiting for their orders. You can stop this tracking at any time by going "Offline".

quotes.text:
I’ve been building software for the last few years, mostly working directly on products rather than just doing small freelance tasks.

Web apps, mobile apps, backend systems, payments, real-time systems, admin panels, deployments, the whole thing. Some of the products I’ve worked on are already live.

But honestly, right now things are a little quiet. I don’t have any active client work, and I’m looking for the next thing to work on.

So if anyone here has a project that needs a developer, needs help finishing something, or knows someone looking for a Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer, I’d genuinely appreciate you reaching out.

I’m comfortable taking something from an existing codebase and fixing/building it, or starting something from scratch.
